title: Rhythm Tap
short_description: 4-lane rhythm game — tap in time with the beat
long_description:
Rhythm Tap is a self-contained single-page HTML5 game from the Omega Games library. 4-lane rhythm game — tap in time with falling beats.

Controls: tap/click or keyboard (arrow keys / WASD). No installation, no account, no external network calls — the whole game is one HTML file that runs entirely in the browser tab it's loaded in.

It's a short-session arcade title built for quick, replayable rounds.

Built for embedding: the page has no iframe-blocking headers, so it drops straight into a portal frame at any size. Session length is short (seconds to a few minutes per round), which fits browsing/portal traffic patterns rather than a long-form download.

Source id: rhythm_tap. Part of a 21-title batch of small HTML5 games being submitted from the same library — if you like this one, the others share the same lightweight, dependency-free build.
cover_capture_method: playwright chromium headless, local file:// build
